title: Thai Stamppot With Lardons
description: A twist on traditional Dutch stamppot, this Thai-inspired dish combines crispy lardons and a tangy sauce with boiled potatoes and kale.
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
Meanwhile, heat the lardons in a pan over medium-high heat until crispy.
Add the molten sauce, sour sauce, soy sauce, and green curry paste to the pan with the lardons.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Once the potatoes are done, mash them with a fork and add to the pan with the lardons and sauce.
Stir to combine and serve immediately.
